findings.text: the control "a category whose name and pulses show no kind is left without one and counted, never given a guessed kind" selects its subject by the classifier's own output, so a run that guessed a kind on a genuinely ambiguous category simply does not select that category, and the control passes on any classifier, including a wrong one — unlike the section's second control, which now uses a constructed pulse, this one has no constructed input that a guessing rule must decline
